title: [inductor][NVGEMM] Adapt dense EFC to direct CuTeDSL epilogues
body:

Teach the vendored dense EFC provider to consume the shared CuTeDSL epilogue
fragment without requiring a CUTLASS EVT DAG. The adapter supplies EFC's
load, broadcast remapping, and store protocol while routing the fragment's
operations through the EFC configuration during parameter analysis and JIT.

Keep support for the existing EVT metadata contract in this commit so the
scheduler migration can be reviewed separately. Share the operation scope
with the block-scaled provider to keep both direct execution paths aligned.

Test Plan:

```text
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1 python test/inductor/test_nv_universal_gemm.py -k matmul_pointwise_epilogue_fusion -v
```
